messages:
Maya (AE): Heads-up — large prospect (fintech) wants a 3mo POC next quarter. They want API + Optimize + Console (3 seats + audit logs add-on). Asking for bundled pricing + a short committed discount if POC goes to pilot. Can @Jules / @Sanjay advise on what we can offer for a POC vs a committed deal?

Sanjay (Solutions Eng): Quick notes on technical side: POC workload ~500M tokens total over 3 months, plus Optimize eval runs (approx 2k evals) and Console seats for 3 engineers. No special infra needs beyond standard hosted. Security ask: SOC2 + SSO + more detailed questionnaire (will attach).

Jules (RevOps): tagging to start deal desk flow. Quick sketch of pricing (list):
```
API (on-hosted list): $0.0008 / token
Optimize: $2,000 / month (base) + $0.25 / eval
Console seat: $400 / seat / month
Audit logs add-on: $600 / month
```
For a short POC we usually offer credits rather than list discounts. For cross-product bundling we can do a stacked approach: credits for POC + a committed discount if they convert.

Claire (Sales-Eng): Prospect wants a single line-item price for procurement. They asked for 20-30% off list if we commit to a 12-month reserved capacity after POC. Also asked whether Optimize fees can be waived during POC.

Jules (RevOps): Rules of thumb:
- POC credits: ok up to $75k approved by RevOps for qualifying deals.
- Cross-product discount: up to 20% allowed at manager level if there's a >= $X committed ARR/commit (we'll need to check commit threshold).
- >25% requires Director approval and documented ROI case.

Maya (AE): Prospect roadmap: if POC succeeds they expect 12–24 month commit. Rough ARR target from them ~$180k/year. That would likely meet commit thresholds?

Jules (RevOps): $180k ARR should clear manager approval for 20% cross-product bundle discount. For POC: recommend $50k credits (covers API + Optimize usage) + 3 months of Console seats free. If they sign a 12mo commit within 30 days of POC completion, step-down pricing to 20% off list for all three products. Anything more aggressive needs Dir sign-off.

Sanjay (Solutions Eng): From infra/ops POV, Optimize evals are compute heavy but small count. We can cap eval runs in the POC credit to avoid runaway cost. Also recommend enabling prefix caching for API to control token spend.

Leo (Legal): Security questionnaire note: we can provide SOC2 report and SSO support docs. For audit logs add-on we need to confirm retention and export format. If they require custom contract clauses (data residency, indemnity caps) that'll add time — estimate 2–3 weeks for contract redlines.

Maya (AE): Prospect also asked for a written rate card with the proposed bundle + POC terms to present to procurement. Can someone assemble a concise attachment? Preferably with: list price, POC credits, post-POC commit discount, and signature path.

Jules (RevOps): I'll draft. Proposed language: "POC: $50,000 in platform credits (covers API & Optimize usage), Console seats (3 seats) provided at no charge for 3 months. Post-POC conversion: 12-month committed contract at 20% off list pricing across API, Optimize, and Console. Audit logs add-on billed at list unless otherwise negotiated."

Claire (Sales-Eng): Minor tweak: make the POC credit explicitly capped per-token for API (e.g., credits redeemable up to $X equivalent at list). Also call out that Optimize evals over 2k will incur extra fees.

Jules (RevOps): Good call. I'll put caps in the draft.

Maya (AE): Timeline: POC start target 2028-05-01. Need final sign-off from deal desk + legal by 2028-04-20 to hit that.

ruth-bot: @channel Deal Desk request created: DD-2028-0321. Please add final draft pricing and attach the security questionnaire.

Jules (RevOps): Action items: 1) I'll post the draft rate card (ETA today EOD). 2) @Leo will confirm security docs and flag any contract objections (ETA 2 business days). 3) @Sanjay will share POC usage guardrails and token caps (ETA tomorrow). 4) @Claire/Maya to own prospect communication.

Leo (Legal): One note — if they insist on custom indemnity/data residency we need commercial sign-off. But nothing flagged yet.

Maya (AE): Thanks all. If RevOps posts the draft I'll send it to the customer and attach the SOC2 + sample SSO doc. Will also ask procurement if the 20% + credits model is acceptable. I'll update thread once they respond. :thumbsup:

Claire (Sales-Eng): LGTM. Keep me in the loop on any ask to push >20%.

Jules (RevOps): Draft uploaded to DD-2028-0321 (see internal link). Asking for manager approval for the 20% bundle + $50k POC credits.

ruth-bot: Manager approval requested. Status: pending.

Maya (AE): Noted — bumping internally.

(End of thread)
